preflightDefectFixed.defect: The preflight DO block was dollar-quoted with a single $ instead of $$ (do $ ... $;), which Postgres rejects with 42601 syntax error at or near "$". The block is the first statement in the candidate, so every apply attempt would have failed before creating anything.
preflightDefectFixed.fix: Quoted the block with the named tag $preflight$, matching the $body$ tags used elsewhere in the file.
